events.message: Actual resource descriptors extracted from official HTML; these are NOT infrastructure observations.
No licensed infrastructure snapshot configured. Catalog links are not cable observations; obtain the official resource and reuse rights first.
Personal GFW token not configured; Documented study areas not configured. No GFW website scraping or replacement activity records.

limitations: Empirical exposure is separate from the synthetic classification experiment. No CAB crosswalk or fault labels exist here.
Scraped catalog resource descriptors are metadata, not measured cable/landing observations.
GFW apparent fishing and presence are AIS-derived estimates, not cable contact, anchoring, faults or fault probabilities.
Infrastructure snapshot dates and activity periods may differ; do not infer historical operation or a time-series inventory.
Country context does not measure exposure along a particular cable. Landing buffers are coastal proxies, not cable routes.
Areas can overlap; their activity totals must not be added as a deduplicated global total.
Absent records/coverage remain unavailable rather than being replaced with zero or imputed coordinates.

gfw.period_rationale: Proposed complete-year acquisition window only. Verify infrastructure snapshot alignment before interpreting a combined analysis.
